newsitem.title: USA: IGA Inc opens seven stores in South Africa.
newsitem.headline: IGA Inc opens seven stores in South Africa.

text.p: IGA Inc said Friday it opened seven stores in South Africa, part of a plan to establish more than 200 supermarkets in the region over the next five years.

The seven independently owned stores will offer more fresh, frozen and prepared foods than the other leading grocery chains already operating in South Africa, IGA said. Annual sales in the area could top $468 million, the company said.
IGA, a multinational supermarket group, posts annual combined sales of more than $16.8 billion. The company's alliance of 3,600 supermarkets operates in 23 nations.
